lessons.what_happened: Called DOWN at 61% on a $-18 move from the open. BTC settled $+9 on the other side of the open. After the call the price reversed back through the open and never came back.
lessons.lesson: Thin move + the cold band: a sub-70% call on a sub-$25 drift is the desk's known leak — this band has run near 50%, not its stated ~65%. The $5 rulebook's 0.70 floor exists because of calls like this.

lessons.what_happened: Called DOWN at 67% on a $-48 move from the open. BTC settled $+113 on the other side of the open. After the call the price reversed back through the open and never came back.
lessons.lesson: The cold band again: 60–70% calls are the desk's least honest range. Counted, printed, and the reason the real-money draft puts its floor at 0.70.
